description: Unique identifier for each loan record
null_handling: NOT NULL — reject row if missing

description: Unique identifier for the borrower linked to dim_customer
null_handling: NOT NULL — reject row if missing

description: Total loan amount requested by the borrower in USD
transformation_rule: Cast to DECIMAL(12 2); multiply by 1 to drop trailing spaces
null_handling: NOT NULL — default 0 if missing (flag in audit log)

description: Actual amount funded by investors in USD
null_handling: NOT NULL — default to loan_amnt if missing

description: Loan repayment term in months (36 or 60 months)
transformation_rule: Strip ' months' suffix; keep integer string

description: Annual interest rate on the loan as a decimal fraction
transformation_rule: Strip '%' suffix; divide by 100; cast to DECIMAL(6 4)
null_handling: NOT NULL — reject row if missing

description: Monthly payment amount in USD
null_handling: NOT NULL — recalculate from loan_amnt/term/int_rate if missing

description: Lending Club assigned loan grade from A (best) to G (worst)
transformation_rule: Uppercase; validate in set A B C D E F G
null_handling: NOT NULL — reject row if missing

description: Lending Club sub-grade refining the loan grade (e.g. C3)
null_handling: NOT NULL — derive from grade + '3' if missing

description: Self-reported annual income of the borrower in USD
transformation_rule: Cast to DECIMAL; cap outliers at 99th percentile (1200000)
null_handling: NULL allowed — impute with median income for grade

description: Debt-to-income ratio excluding mortgage as a percentage
null_handling: NULL allowed — impute with median DTI for grade

description: Date the loan was funded and issued
transformation_rule: Parse 'Mon-YYYY' format to ISO date YYYY-MM-01
null_handling: NOT NULL — reject row if missing

description: Current status of the loan (e.g. Fully Paid; Charged Off; Current)
transformation_rule: Capitalise; trim whitespace; validate against allowed list
null_handling: NOT NULL — reject row if missing

description: Binary flag: 1 if loan is in default or charged off; 0 otherwise
transformation_rule: CASE WHEN loan_status IN ('Default' 'Charged Off') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
null_handling: NOT NULL — always derivable from loan_status

description: Probability of Default estimate from scorecard model (0–1)
null_handling: NOT NULL — model always produces a score

description: Loss Given Default assumption (percentage of EAD lost)
transformation_rule: Lookup from dim_risk_band by grade; range 0.35–0.75
null_handling: NOT NULL — from risk band config

description: Exposure at Default: outstanding balance at time of default
transformation_rule: funded_amnt minus total_pymnt up to default date; min 0

description: Expected Loss = PD × LGD × EAD in USD
Risk classification band assigned by the scorecard model
transformation_rule: Lookup from dim_risk_band using pd_estimate range

description: Total current revolving balance across all credit lines in USD
transformation_rule: Cast to DECIMAL(14 2); cap at 99th percentile
null_handling: NULL allowed — set to 0 if missing

description: Revolving line utilisation rate as a percentage
transformation_rule: Strip '%'; cast to DECIMAL(6 3); clip to [0; 100]
null_handling: NULL allowed — impute with grade median

description: Number of delinquencies in the past 2 years

null_handling: NOT NULL — set to 0 if missing
